node.title: Re: Issues with Net::SCP::Expect
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: [mod://Net::SCP::Expect] was last released 10 years ago and has several open issues. Since you seem to be running on a *NIX system and running an external ssh doesn't seem to be an issue, I'd strongly suggest you try [mod://Net::OpenSSH] instead (see its scp_get and scp_put methods).
